final: SELECT MediaType.Name, AVG(1.0 * Track.Bytes / Track.Milliseconds) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(1.0 * Track.Bytes / Track.Milliseconds) - (SELECT AVG(media_average) FROM (SELECT AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS media_average FROM Track AS t WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId)) AS above_overall_average FROM Track JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId WHERE Track.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY MediaType.MediaTypeId, MediaType.Name HAVING AVG(1.0 * Track.Bytes / Track.Milliseconds) > (SELECT AVG(media_average) FROM (SELECT AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS media_average FROM Track AS t WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId))
